Acceptance `CHK-318`: checkout HTTP calls default to 3000 ms; accept `CHECKOUT_TIMEOUT_MS` integers 1000..10000; invalid values retain 3000; preserve all other checkout behavior.
Policy: PR description must state motivation, behavior, non-goals, tests, rollout, residual risk. Required checks: `npm test`, `npm run lint`. Review security-sensitive configuration parsing before call-site changes.
Diff:
- `src/config.ts` index `10aa000..20bb000`: retain `checkoutBaseUrl = process.env.CHECKOUT_BASE_URL`; add `checkoutTimeoutMs(raw = process.env.CHECKOUT_TIMEOUT_MS)`: undefined→3000; `value=Number(raw)`; return value iff integer and 1000≤value≤10000, else 3000.
- `src/checkout.ts` index `30cc000..40dd000`: import `checkoutTimeoutMs` from `./config`; change `http.post("/checkout", body)` to `http.post("/checkout", body, { timeout: checkoutTimeoutMs() })`.
- New `test/checkout-timeout.test.ts`, mode 100644: parameter cases `[undefined,3000]`, `["1000",1000]`, `["10000",10000]`, `["999",3000]`, `["10001",3000]`, `["abc",3000]`; async call `submitCheckout({cartId:"c1"})` expects `http.post("/checkout", {cartId:"c1"}, {timeout:3000})`.
Fresh verification at head `2222222`, 2026-08-21: `npm test -- checkout-timeout` exit 0, 7 passed, report `artifacts/checkout-timeout.junit.xml`; `npm test` exit 0, 418 passed/0 failed/2 explicitly skipped integration tests, report `artifacts/junit.xml`; `npm run lint` exit 0, 0 errors/0 warnings.
Owner rollout decision: initially deploy with variable unset; after observing checkout latency, set per environment. Roll back by unsetting it. No database/API compatibility change expected.
Output in order: `## Review map`, `## Verification evidence`, `## Residual risk`, `## Pull-request draft`. Trace every claim to diff, command result, or labeled owner decision. Map parser, checkout call site, and tests to `CHK-318`; parser is first hotspot. Include exact refs/range, clean/complete status, commands/exits/counts/artifacts, skipped integrations, runtime-environment-configuration risk, rollout/rollback, motivation, behavior, non-goals, and unresolved risk; do not claim approval/readiness merely from description completeness.
